left.title: Distorted Videos of Nancy Pelosi Spread on Facebook and Twitter, Helped by Trump
left.body: Manipulated videos of Speaker Nancy Pelosi that made it seem as if she were stumbling over and slurring her words continued to spread across social media on Friday, fueled by President Trump’s feud with the Democratic leader. One of the videos, which showed Ms. Pelosi speaking at a conference this week, appeared to be slowed down to make her speech sound continually garbled.
left.roundup: Edited videos of Speaker Nancy Pelosi spread all over social media that made it seem as if she had slurred and stumbled over her words. The videos have been viewed over a million times and were said to be fueled by President Trump's feud with Pelosi.

center.title: MSNBC's Wallace alters video of herself to show how Trump tried to 'smear' Pelosi
center.body: MSNBC's Nicolle Wallace on Friday showed an altered video clip of herself to blast President Trump’s attempt to "smear" Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.) with an edited video. The “Deadline: White House” host said on her show that the clash between Trump and Pelosi this week has “deteriorated to a level beneath words — comprehensible words at least.” “That’s why we’re going to do something different here to make sure you understand just how low the president has stooped in his efforts to smear the Speaker of the House,”
center.roundup: Edited videos of Speaker Nancy Pelosi spread all over social media that made it seem as if she had slurred and stumbled over her words. The videos have been viewed over a million times and were said to be fueled by President Trump's feud with Pelosi.

right.title: Facebook defends not pulling controversial video of Pelosi
right.body: Facebook has released a statement amid concerns about its decision not to remove an altered video that went viral -- one concocted to make it seem that House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, D-Calif., was slurring her words. Although the social media giant triggered a backlash by not taking down the vid, it said it did reduce the content's distribution and add a disclaimer notifying users that the video was "false."
right.roundup: Edited videos of Speaker Nancy Pelosi spread all over social media that made it seem as if she had slurred and stumbled over her words. The videos have been viewed over a million times and were said to be fueled by President Trump's feud with Pelosi.
